stemMd: Which change would most directly address a problem identified in the passage?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Reducing crate losses so each crate completes more useful journeys.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Counting every crate as infinitely reusable regardless of loss.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Painting all crates a more fashionable colour.

explanationMd: Loss after few deliveries prevents manufacturing impacts being distributed over many uses. Reducing such losses directly targets a stated operational weakness. The passage does not imply that reuse is automatically better under every transport pattern.

distractorRationale.e: The identified problems concern reuse and logistics.
distractorRationale.d: Those trips can contribute to the impacts being assessed.
distractorRationale.c: The passage stresses actual rather than assumed reuse.
distractorRationale.b: That would restore the initial incomplete comparison.
